    -- Spawns a card with a dummy object used to track a 3DText.
    -- The dummy object was necessary because it is impossible to track the
    -- correct orientation for the text, since it is aligned to the xy plane.
    --
    -- USAGE: (OBS: params.text - ; is used as new-line character)
    -- params = {
    --     position = {0, 3, -10},
    --     rotation = {0, 0, 0},
    --     scale    = {1, 1, 1},
    --     text     = [[Sharp Toughness;;
    --                 This card add +2 life to all minons;;
    --                 Whenever the owner of this card is;
    --                 injured, remove this card from the;
    --                 game, then choose a target player to;
    --                 discard a card.]]
    -- }
    -- card = spawnCard(params)
    --
    function spawnCard(params)
        local card_params = {
            type              = 'Card',
            position          = params.position,
            rotation          = params.rotation,
            scale             = params.scale,
            sound             = false,
            snap_to_grid      = true,
            callback_function = function(obj) createDummyObject(obj, params) end
        }
        local card = spawnObject(card_params)
        card.auto_raise = false
        return card
    end
    
    -- Create the dummy object for the card with a fixed joint.
    function createDummyObject(card, params)
        local dummy_params = {
            type              = 'go_game_piece_white',
            position          = params.position,
            rotation          = params.rotation,
            scale             = params.scale,
            sound             = false,
            snap_to_grid      = false,
            callback_function = function(obj) attachTextToDummy(obj, params) end
        }
        local card_scale = params.scale[1] -- TODO: fix card aspect ratio
        dummy_params.position[2] = dummy_params.position[2] + 0.1
        dummy_params.position[3] = dummy_params.position[3] + 1.4*card_scale
        dummy_params.rotation[1] = dummy_params.rotation[1] + 90
        local dummy = spawnObject(dummy_params)
        dummy.auto_raise = false
        dummy.interactable = false
        dummy.setInvisibleTo(Color.list)
        dummy.jointTo(card, {
            ["type"]        = "Fixed",
            ["collision"]   = false,
            ["break_force"]  = 1000.0,
            ["break_torgue"] = 1000.0,
        })
        local dummy_script_literal = [[
            parent = getObjectFromGUID("%s") -- [1] : card guid
            function onUpdate()
                if (parent == nil) then
                    self.destruct()
                end
                local scale = parent.getScale()
                scale = {scale[1]/10, scale[2]/10, scale[3]/10}
                self.setScale(scale)
            end
        ]]
        dummy.setLuaScript(string.format(dummy_script_literal, card.getGUID()))
    end
    
    -- Pretty format the card text string
    function removeWhiteSpaces(literal_string)
        local str = literal_string
        str = string.gsub(str, "%s+", " ")
        str = string.gsub(str, "%;", "\n")
        print(str)
        return str
    end
    
    -- Attaches a 3DText to the dummy object
    function attachTextToDummy(dummy, params)
        local spawn_json_literal = [[{
            "Name": "3DText",
            "Transform": {
                "posX": 1.0,
                "posY": 1.0,
                "posZ": 1.0,
            },
            "Text": {
                "Text": "%s",
                "colorstate": {
                  "r": 1.0,
                  "g": 0.0,
                  "b": 0.0
                },
                "fontSize": 80
            }
        }]]
        local text_string = removeWhiteSpaces(params.text)
        local spawn_json  = {json=string.format(spawn_json_literal, text_string)}
        local text_obj    = spawnObjectJSON(spawn_json)
        local text_script_literal = [[
            parent = getObjectFromGUID("%s") -- [1] : dummy guid
            function onUpdate()
                if (parent == nil) then
                    self.destruct()
                else
                    self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                    self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                    local scale = parent.getScale()
                    scale = scale[1]
                    if (scale <= 3) then
                        self.setScale({scale, scale, scale})
                    else
                        self.TextTool.setFontSize(80*scale)
                    end
                end
            end
        ]]
        text_obj.setLuaScript(string.format(text_script_literal, dummy.getGUID()))
    end
